catalog.label: Static memory fraction
catalog.help: Share of the GPU memory free at start-up that weights and the KV cache pool may use; the rest is headroom for activations, CUDA graphs and kernel scratch. Unset: SGLang derives it from the card.

catalog.label: Max total tokens (KV pool)
catalog.help: Hard cap on the tokens in the KV pool; normally derived from mem-fraction-static. For development and debugging.

catalog.label: KV cache dtype
catalog.help: KV storage type. fp8_e4m3 halves KV memory against bf16; the nvfp4 and fp4 types need CUDA 12.8 or newer and are less proven.

catalog.label: CPU offload
catalog.help: GB of host RAM used to offload weights. Slow over PCIe; a last resort.

catalog.label: SWA/full KV token ratio
catalog.help: Sliding-window-layer KV tokens as a ratio of full-attention KV tokens (hybrid sliding-window models).

catalog.label: Disable hybrid SWA pool
catalog.help: Disable the hybrid sliding-window KV pool.

catalog.label: KV page size
catalog.help: Tokens per KV page. Some backends need a fixed size (FlashMLA and the TRT-LLM ones use 64).

catalog.label: Memory saver
catalog.help: Allow the engine to release and resume its memory (reinforcement-learning and co-location setups).

catalog.label: Mamba state slots
catalog.help: Maximum size of the Mamba (linear-attention) state cache of hybrid models; it also limits how many requests can run at once.

catalog.label: Mamba SSM state dtype
catalog.help: Data type of the SSM state in the Mamba cache. Unset reads it from the model config.

catalog.label: Mamba radix cache strategy
catalog.help: How Mamba states are cached for prefix reuse: auto, no_buffer, extra_buffer or extra_buffer_lazy.

catalog.label: Mamba track interval
catalog.help: Interval, in tokens, at which the Mamba state is tracked during decode for the prefix cache.

catalog.label: Hierarchical KV cache (HiCache)
catalog.help: Spill KV blocks to host RAM or storage. Needs the radix cache.

catalog.label: HiCache host/device ratio
catalog.help: Host KV pool size relative to the device pool. Unset: 2.0 in cache mode.

catalog.label: HiCache host size
catalog.help: Host pool size in GB; overrides hicache-ratio.

catalog.label: HiCache write policy
catalog.help: How device KV is written to the host tier.

catalog.label: HiCache IO backend
catalog.help: Kernel used to copy KV between CPU and GPU.

catalog.label: HiCache host layout
catalog.help: Layout of the host memory pool.

catalog.label: HiCache storage backend
catalog.help: Optional third tier below host RAM.

catalog.label: Context length
catalog.help: Maximum context (prompt plus output). Defaults to the model config. Longer than the model's native length needs SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN=1 and rope scaling in json_model_override_args.

catalog.label: Allow context beyond the model's length
catalog.help: Sets SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN=1 so a context_length above the derived length is accepted with a warning instead of an error. Pair it with a rope-scaling block in json_model_override_args; quality beyond the trained length is not guaranteed.

catalog.label: Chunked prefill size
catalog.help: Tokens per prefill chunk; -1 disables chunked prefill. Smaller means less activation memory and smoother decode latency. Unset: chosen from the card's memory.

catalog.label: Max prefill tokens
catalog.help: Maximum tokens in one prefill batch (the real bound is the larger of this and the context length).

catalog.label: Auto-truncate long prompts
catalog.help: Truncate over-long inputs instead of returning an error.

catalog.label: Model config overrides (JSON)
catalog.help: JSON object that overrides config.json values, for example a rope-scaling block for YaRN.

catalog.label: Model revision
catalog.help: Branch, tag or commit of the model repository.

catalog.label: Trust remote code
catalog.help: Allow custom modelling code from the Hub. It executes downloaded code: only for reviewed repositories.

catalog.label: Tokenizer path
catalog.help: Tokenizer repository or path, if it differs from the model's.

catalog.label: Model implementation
catalog.help: auto, sglang or transformers. auto uses SGLang's own implementation and falls back to Transformers.

catalog.label: Enable multimodal
catalog.help: Enable the multimodal path for the served model (no effect on a text-only model).

catalog.label: Language model only
catalog.help: Skip the multimodal encoder entirely: its weights are never loaded, which frees that memory for KV cache. Image and video requests are rejected.

catalog.label: Embedding mode
catalog.help: Serve a causal language model as an embedding model.

catalog.label: Max remote media size
catalog.help: Largest remote image, video or audio download one request may trigger; 0 disables the limit.

catalog.label: Default template kwargs (JSON)
catalog.help: Default kwargs for the chat template on every request, for example {"enable_thinking": true}. A request's own chat_template_kwargs wins.

catalog.label: Sampling defaults source
catalog.help: Where default sampling parameters come from: the model's generation_config.json (model) or SGLang's own (openai).

catalog.label: Weights/activation dtype
catalog.help: Compute dtype. auto uses BF16 for BF16 models and FP16 for FP16 and FP32 models.

catalog.label: Quantization
catalog.help: Weight quantization method. Pre-quantized checkpoints (NVFP4, AWQ, GPTQ) carry their own config, so leave it unset or give the matching value (modelopt_fp4 for a ModelOpt NVFP4 checkpoint). fp8 quantizes a BF16 model while loading.

catalog.label: Weight load format
catalog.help: Format of the weights to load; auto picks safetensors when present.

catalog.label: FP8 GEMM backend
catalog.help: Runner for blockwise FP8 GEMM. cutlass is the SM120-tuned choice per the help; auto selects by hardware.

catalog.label: FP4 GEMM backend
catalog.help: Runner for NVFP4 GEMM. auto picks flashinfer_cutlass on SM120 and marlin (weight-only) on SM80 to SM90.

catalog.label: MoE runner backend
catalog.help: Kernel backend for MoE experts. Test before forcing one: auto and flashinfer_cutlass are the usual choices for NVFP4 MoE on sm_120.

catalog.label: Tensor parallel size
catalog.help: GPUs per replica (--tp-size). Must not exceed the GPUs selected.

catalog.label: Data parallel size
catalog.help: Number of replicas (or attention data-parallel groups when enable-dp-attention is on).

catalog.label: Expert parallel size
catalog.help: Expert parallelism for MoE models; must divide tp-size.

catalog.label: Pipeline parallel size
catalog.help: Number of pipeline stages.

catalog.label: DP attention
catalog.help: Data-parallel attention with tensor-parallel FFN layers. dp-size must equal tp-size. Supported for DeepSeek-style and Qwen MoE models.

catalog.label: MoE all-to-all backend
catalog.help: All-to-all backend for expert parallelism.

catalog.label: Expert-parallel load balancer
catalog.help: Enable the expert-parallel load balancer (needs expert parallelism).

catalog.label: Redundant experts
catalog.help: Extra redundant experts for the load balancer.

catalog.label: Disable custom all-reduce
catalog.help: Fall back to NCCL all-reduce (try this if tensor parallelism hangs on a PCIe-only machine).

catalog.label: Node count
catalog.help: Number of machines. This console runs single-node engines.

catalog.label: Max running requests
catalog.help: Cap on requests running at once; it also sizes the CUDA-graph batch and the Mamba caches. Unset: derived from the card.

catalog.label: Max queued requests
catalog.help: Reject new requests once this many are queued.

catalog.label: Schedule policy
catalog.help: Request ordering. lpm (longest prefix match) favours cache hits; fcfs is first come, first served.

catalog.label: Schedule conservativeness
catalog.help: How conservative admission is: larger means more careful. Raise it if requests are retracted often.

catalog.label: Mixed chunk
catalog.help: Mix prefill and decode tokens in one batch (needs chunked prefill).

catalog.label: Priority scheduling
catalog.help: Schedule requests with higher priority numbers first.

catalog.label: Disable overlap scheduler
catalog.help: Turn off the overlap of CPU scheduling with GPU work (debugging).

catalog.label: Stream interval
catalog.help: Tokens per streamed chunk: lower is smoother, higher gives more throughput.

catalog.label: Sleep on idle
catalog.help: Reduce CPU usage while the engine is idle.

catalog.label: Watchdog timeout
catalog.help: Crash if one forward batch takes longer than this; raise it for very long prefills.

catalog.label: Attention backend
catalog.help: Attention kernels. flashinfer, triton and trtllm_mha run on sm_120; fa3 is built for Hopper and the *_mla backends for DeepSeek-style models.

catalog.label: Prefill attention backend
catalog.help: Override the attention backend for prefill only.

catalog.label: Decode attention backend
catalog.help: Override the attention backend for decode only.

catalog.label: Sampling backend
catalog.help: Kernels for the sampling layers.

catalog.label: Grammar backend
catalog.help: Backend for constrained (JSON or regex) decoding.

catalog.label: Disable radix cache
catalog.help: Turn off RadixAttention prefix caching (it hurts agent and multi-turn workloads).

catalog.label: Radix eviction policy
catalog.help: Which cached prefixes are dropped first when the cache is full.

catalog.label: torch.compile
catalog.help: Experimental: long warm-up, helps small-batch decode.

catalog.label: torch.compile max batch
catalog.help: Largest batch size compiled with torch.compile.

catalog.label: CUDA graph max batch (decode)
catalog.help: Largest decode batch captured as a CUDA graph; bigger means more graph memory and capture time. Unset: derived from the card.

catalog.label: CUDA graph backend (decode)
catalog.help: full, breakable, tc_piecewise or disabled. Replaces the deprecated --disable-cuda-graph.

catalog.label: CUDA graph backend (prefill)
catalog.help: Prefill-phase graph backend; disabled saves memory and capture time.

catalog.label: CUDA graph max tokens (prefill)
catalog.help: Largest prefill size captured as a CUDA graph.

catalog.label: Batch tokenization
catalog.help: Tokenize concurrent text inputs in one batch (not for image inputs).

catalog.label: Deterministic inference
catalog.help: Batch-invariant kernels for reproducible outputs; slower.

catalog.label: Skip warmup
catalog.help: Skip the warm-up request at start-up.

catalog.label: Disable FlashInfer autotune
catalog.help: Skip FlashInfer's autotuning pass at start-up (faster start, possibly slower kernels).

catalog.label: Mamba SSM backend
catalog.help: Kernel backend for Mamba state operations: triton (the default) or flashinfer.

catalog.label: Linear-attention backend
catalog.help: Default kernel backend for linear attention (gated delta net and KDA layers).

catalog.label: Linear-attention decode backend
catalog.help: Override the linear-attention backend for decode. Unset follows linear-attn-backend.

catalog.label: Linear-attention prefill backend
catalog.help: Override the linear-attention backend for prefill. Unset follows linear-attn-backend.

catalog.label: Tool-call parser
catalog.help: Needed by agentic clients: without it tool calls stay raw text and tool_calls is empty. It must match the model's dialect (Qwen3.x and Coder-style XML needs qwen3_coder, not qwen).

catalog.label: Reasoning parser
catalog.help: Splits the model's <think> output into reasoning_content.

catalog.label: Chat template
catalog.help: Built-in template name or a template file path inside the container.

catalog.label: Served model name
catalog.help: Name returned by /v1/models. Overrides the name the console provides.

catalog.label: Preferred sampling params
catalog.help: JSON sampling defaults advertised by /get_model_info.

catalog.label: Report cached tokens
catalog.help: Return the number of cached prompt tokens in usage.prompt_tokens_details.

catalog.label: Speculative algorithm
catalog.help: EAGLE, EAGLE3 and STANDALONE need a draft model; NEXTN uses the model's built-in MTP head; NGRAM needs no draft model; DFLASH and DSPARK are newer drafters.

catalog.label: Draft model
catalog.help: Hugging Face repository or path of the draft model.

catalog.label: Draft steps
catalog.help: Steps sampled from the draft model.

catalog.label: EAGLE top-k
catalog.help: Tokens sampled per draft step (1 means chain drafting).

catalog.label: Draft tokens
catalog.help: Tokens verified per step. With top-k 1, SGLang forces this to steps plus one.

catalog.label: Accept threshold
catalog.help: Accept a draft token if its probability in the target model exceeds this.

catalog.label: Draft quantization
catalog.help: Quantization of the draft model (unquant keeps it unquantized).

catalog.label: Enable LoRA
catalog.help: Enable LoRA serving (implied by lora-paths).

catalog.label: LoRA adapters
catalog.help: Adapters as <path> or <name>=<path>.

catalog.label: Max LoRAs per batch
catalog.help: Adapters (including base-only requests) in one running batch.

catalog.label: Max LoRA rank
catalog.help: Largest adapter rank. Inferred from the adapters when unset.

catalog.label: LoRA backend
catalog.help: Kernel backend for multi-LoRA serving.

catalog.label: Prometheus metrics
catalog.help: Exposes /metrics. The console always turns this on; setting it to false has no effect.

catalog.label: Request time stats logging
catalog.help: Log per-request timing statistics.

catalog.label: Random seed
catalog.help: Seed for sampling reproducibility.

catalog.label: Log level
catalog.help: Logging level of all loggers.

catalog.label: Decode log interval
catalog.help: Decode iterations between log and metric lines.

catalog.label: Log requests
catalog.help: Log metadata, inputs and outputs of every request: this puts prompts into the logs.

catalog.label: OpenTelemetry tracing
catalog.help: Emit OpenTelemetry traces (needs otlp-traces-endpoint).

catalog.label: OTLP endpoint
catalog.help: host:port of the collector when tracing is enabled.
